name: chinese-tts
description: Text normalization and engineering for Mandarin TTS: how to read numbers, years, phone numbers, units, ranges, links and code; holding number boundaries while streaming; choosing and running local engines (Kokoro, CosyVoice, Qwen3-TTS, sherpa-onnx…) for low first-sentence latency, cancellation and caching. Ships 139 golden cases and a checker.
